## Gap ID
SEC-004

## Source
gap-analysis-security

## Description
The FastAPI REST API server (`osimflow serve`) supports API key authentication but defaults to plain HTTP with no TLS enforcement. Credentials and data transit are unprotected.

## Evidence
- `osimflow/api/app.py` — FastAPI server with no TLS configuration
- `--api-key` flag exists but `--tls-cert`/`--tls-key` flags do not

## Severity
Critical

## Recommended Mitigation
Add `--tls-cert` and `--tls-key` CLI flags to `osimflow serve`. Default to requiring TLS when a certificate is provided. Document TLS as required for production deployments.

## Labels
gap-analysis, security, api, tls, critical
